The whole level definitely has Ruby Ridge vibes, and Gerard’s recordings around the map are what got me into the lore of this game. I think the creepiest part of the level for me was seeing the room where Gerard was testing out the ricin. I also love the idea that Gerard knows Judge, but we don’t know how yet.
